title: 大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法
summary: 大斷面側導坑把開挖空間分割成較小區域，但暫時中隔牆及其連接會形成施工期特有的受力系統。本課比較跨度、偏載、牆體剛度與拆除前後的荷載分配，再用測量誤差、階段模型與防水交接檢查推論。課堂的梁、彈簧和壓力算例均不提供拆牆順序或安全許可，學員需辨識何種證據必須由設計者核准。
summaryEn: Side drifts divide a large excavation into smaller regions, while temporary walls and their connections create a construction-specific structural system. This course compares spans, eccentric loading, wall stiffness and load sharing before and after removal, then checks interpretations through survey uncertainty, staged models and waterproofing handover. Beam, spring and pressure examples prescribe neither a removal sequence nor permission; learners identify evidence requiring designer approval.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下原創算例針對雙側導坑的暫時中隔牆、非對稱受力與拆除荷載轉移，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設q=30 kN/m、L=8 m，M=qL²/8=240 kN·m；將理想跨度減為4 m則M=60 kN·m，僅適用相同均布與簡支邊界。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設截面寬12 m，向下力600 kN位於x=2 m、400 kN位於x=10 m，合力位置x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m，偏中心0.8 m。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。
workedExample.textEn: This original worked example examines temporary walls, asymmetry and removal load transfer in side-drift excavation. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=30 kN/m and L=8 m. M=qL²/8=240 kN·m; an ideal 4 m span gives 60 kN·m, under the same uniform loading and simple-support boundaries only. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a 12 m section with downward forces 600 kN at x=2 m and 400 kN at x=10 m. Resultant x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m, 0.8 m from center. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分割跨度與梁式比較」與「左右偏載與合力位置」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Subdivided span and beam comparison" and "Left-right loading and resultant position": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分割跨度與梁式比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Subdivided span and beam comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分割跨度與梁式比較」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Subdivided span and beam comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側導坑降低某些施工階段的開放跨度，同時引入暫時支承和接縫。簡支梁均布荷載可展示跨度平方對彎矩的影響，但真實洞室的三維拱效應與地層互制不能由這個比例直接取代。 假設q=30 kN/m、L=8 m，M=qL²/8=240 kN·m；將理想跨度減為4 m則M=60 kN·m，僅適用相同均布與簡支邊界。 暫時支承未有效連接而被當成簡支點，會把計算跨度縮得過小並低估彎矩；完工斷面看似合理也不能補救施工期支承假設的缺口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分割跨度與梁式比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Side drifts reduce certain open spans while introducing temporary supports and joints. A uniformly loaded simple beam illustrates the squared dependence of moment on span, but the ratio does not replace three-dimensional arching or ground interaction in an actual cavern. Assume q=30 kN/m and L=8 m. M=qL²/8=240 kN·m; an ideal 4 m span gives 60 kN·m, under the same uniform loading and simple-support boundaries only. Treating an unconnected temporary member as an effective simple support artificially shortens the calculated span and understates moment. A plausible completed section does not repair that missing support assumption during construction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Subdivided span and beam comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跨度減半就代表整個地下工程的風險必然減為四分之一。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Halving a span necessarily reduces the risk of the whole underground work to one quarter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分割跨度與梁式比較」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Subdivided span and beam comparison”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分割跨度與梁式比較
knowledge.text: 側導坑降低某些施工階段的開放跨度，同時引入暫時支承和接縫。簡支梁均布荷載可展示跨度平方對彎矩的影響，但真實洞室的三維拱效應與地層互制不能由這個比例直接取代。
knowledge.textEn: Side drifts reduce certain open spans while introducing temporary supports and joints. A uniformly loaded simple beam illustrates the squared dependence of moment on span, but the ratio does not replace three-dimensional arching or ground interaction in an actual cavern.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：跨度減半就代表整個地下工程的風險必然減為四分之一。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Halving a span necessarily reduces the risk of the whole underground work to one quarter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分割跨度與梁式比較」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Subdivided span and beam comparison" is correct?
options: 跨度減半就代表整個地下工程的風險必然減為四分之一。
側導坑降低某些施工階段的開放跨度，同時引入暫時支承和接縫。
左右總荷載加總正確就不必檢查合力的位置。
optionsEn: Halving a span necessarily reduces the risk of the whole underground work to one quarter.
Side drifts reduce certain open spans while introducing temporary supports and joints.
Correctly adding the left and right forces removes the need to check resultant location.
quiz.explanation: 側導坑降低某些施工階段的開放跨度，同時引入暫時支承和接縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Side drifts reduce certain open spans while introducing temporary supports and joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分割跨度與梁式比較：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Subdivided span and beam comparison: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分割跨度與梁式比較」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Subdivided span and beam comparison” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設q=30 kN/m、L=8 m，M=qL²/8=240 kN·m；將理想跨度減為4 m則M=60 kN·m，僅適用相同均布與簡支邊界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=30 kN/m and L=8 m. M=qL²/8=240 kN·m; an ideal 4 m span gives 60 kN·m, under the same uniform loading and simple-support boundaries only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每個施工階段的實際開放範圍與暫時牆位置畫出，檢查支承是否已具備傳力能力；若荷載與支承同時改變，必須重新分析而非只套跨度平方比，由洞室設計者審查模型適用性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw the actual open region and temporary-wall position at each stage, checking whether the support can already transfer load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設q=30 kN/m、L=8 m，M=qL²/8=240 kN·m；將理想跨度減為4 m則M=60 kN·m，僅適用相同均布與簡支邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=30 kN/m and L=8 m. M=qL²/8=240 kN·m; an ideal 4 m span gives 60 kN·m, under the same uniform loading and simple-support boundaries only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分割跨度與梁式比較」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Subdivided span and beam comparison", which statement holds?
options: 中隔牆只承擔軸向壓力，所以不需要考慮偏心彎矩。
只要平均分到各支承的力不大，缺少構件就沒有影響。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A temporary dividing wall carries axial compression only, so eccentric bending need not be considered.
Missing members have no effect as long as the average force per support looks modest.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分割跨度與梁式比較：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Subdivided span and beam comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分割跨度與梁式比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Subdivided span and beam comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每個施工階段的實際開放範圍與暫時牆位置畫出，檢查支承是否已具備傳力能力；若荷載與支承同時改變，必須重新分析而非只套跨度平方比，由洞室設計者審查模型適用性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the actual open region and temporary-wall position at each stage, checking whether the support can already transfer load. When loading and support change together, reanalyze instead of using the squared-span ratio alone; the cavern designer reviews model applicability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：階段圖註明每個支點的完成與驗證條件，沒有證據的支承不可默認有效；任何分割變更交由設計者核准，梁式比例只用於敏感度說明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stage drawings state completion and verification conditions for every support. Unsupported assumptions cannot count as effective restraints. The designer approves subdivision changes; the beam ratio is only a sensitivity illustration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：暫時支承未有效連接而被當成簡支點，會把計算跨度縮得過小並低估彎矩；完工斷面看似合理也不能補救施工期支承假設的缺口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating an unconnected temporary member as an effective simple support artificially shortens the calculated span and understates moment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每個施工階段的實際開放範圍與暫時牆位置畫出，檢查支承是否已具備傳力能力；若荷載與支承同時改變，必須重新分析而非只套跨度平方比，由洞室設計者審查模型適用性。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the actual open region and temporary-wall position at each stage, checking whether the support can already transfer load. When loading and support change together, reanalyze instead of using the squared-span ratio alone; the cavern designer reviews model applicability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 階段圖註明每個支點的完成與驗證條件，沒有證據的支承不可默認有效；任何分割變更交由設計者核准，梁式比例只用於敏感度說明。
knowledge.textEn: Stage drawings state completion and verification conditions for every support. Unsupported assumptions cannot count as effective restraints. The designer approves subdivision changes; the beam ratio is only a sensitivity illustration.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分割跨度與梁式比較」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Subdivided span and beam comparison"?
options: 將每個施工階段的實際開放範圍與暫時牆位置畫出，檢查支承是否已具備傳力能力；若荷載與支承同時改變，必須重新分析而非只套跨度平方比，由洞室設計者審查模型適用性。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
模型全期平均誤差很小便表示每一次構件變更都可靠。
optionsEn: Draw the actual open region and temporary-wall position at each stage, checking whether the support can already transfer load.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A small whole-history average error makes every modeled member change reliable and validated.
quiz.explanation: 將每個施工階段的實際開放範圍與暫時牆位置畫出，檢查支承是否已具備傳力能力；若荷載與支承同時改變，必須重新分析而非只套跨度平方比，由洞室設計者審查模型適用性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw the actual open region and temporary-wall position at each stage, checking whether the support can already transfer load. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分割跨度與梁式比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Subdivided span and beam comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分割跨度與梁式比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Subdivided span and beam comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 暫時支承未有效連接而被當成簡支點，會把計算跨度縮得過小並低估彎矩；完工斷面看似合理也不能補救施工期支承假設的缺口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating an unconnected temporary member as an effective simple support artificially shortens the calculated span and understates moment. A plausible completed section does not repair that missing support assumption during construction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：暫時支承未有效連接而被當成簡支點，會把計算跨度縮得過小並低估彎矩；完工斷面看似合理也不能補救施工期支承假設的缺口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A plausible completed section does not repair that missing support assumption during construction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨度減半就代表整個地下工程的風險必然減為四分之一。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Halving a span necessarily reduces the risk of the whole underground work to one quarter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 左右偏載與合力位置：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Left-right loading and resultant position: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「左右偏載與合力位置」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Left-right loading and resultant position” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 左右導坑進度或地層不同，可能使合力偏離整體中心並產生額外力矩。將荷載乘其力臂可定位合力，卻不代表襯砌各點反力已知；暫時牆和外環的剛度仍控制內力分配。 假設截面寬12 m，向下力600 kN位於x=2 m、400 kN位於x=10 m，合力位置x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m，偏中心0.8 m。 左右資料被分開存檔或時間錯位，會將真實非對稱誤看成兩組正常反應；因此中隔牆的側向需求和外環偏心可能未在施工期模型中被捕捉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「左右偏載與合力位置」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different side-drift progress or ground conditions can shift the resultant away from the section center, creating additional moment. Force times lever arm locates the resultant but does not determine every lining reaction; wall and outer-ring stiffness still control distribution. Assume a 12 m section with downward forces 600 kN at x=2 m and 400 kN at x=10 m. Resultant x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m, 0.8 m from center. Separately stored or mistimed left-right records can make genuine asymmetry look like two normal responses. Temporary-wall lateral demand and outer-ring eccentricity may then be absent from the construction-stage interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Left-right loading and resultant position” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「左右總荷載加總正確就不必檢查合力的位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correctly adding the left and right forces removes the need to check resultant location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「左右偏載與合力位置」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Different side-drift progress or ground conditions can shift the resultant away from the section center, creating additional moment. Force times lever arm locates the resultant but does not determine every lining reaction; wall and outer-ring stiffness still control distribution.

knowledge.text: 誤解：左右總荷載加總正確就不必檢查合力的位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 左右偏載與合力位置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Left-right loading and resultant position: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「左右偏載與合力位置」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Left-right loading and resultant position” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設截面寬12 m，向下力600 kN位於x=2 m、400 kN位於x=10 m，合力位置x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m，偏中心0.8 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a 12 m section with downward forces 600 kN at x=2 m and 400 kN at x=10 m. Resultant x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m, 0.8 m from center. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以一致坐標標出左右地層、施工進度與量測反應，確認合力方向和力臂定義；對比偏載情境的預測與拱頂側移，不可用總沉陷較小消除偏載疑慮，需結構與地工人員共同判斷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use common coordinates for left-right ground, construction progress and measured response, checking force directions and lever arms.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設截面寬12 m，向下力600 kN位於x=2 m、400 kN位於x=10 m，合力位置x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m，偏中心0.8 m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a 12 m section with downward forces 600 kN at x=2 m and 400 kN at x=10 m. Resultant x=(600×2+400×10)/1000=5.2 m, 0.8 m from center.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「左右偏載與合力位置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Left-right loading and resultant position", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
外荷載不變就表示拆除一個支承後其他構件內力不變。
任何兩項量測不確定度都可直接平方和開根號。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Unchanged external loading means that removing one support cannot change forces in the others.
Any two measurement uncertainties can always be combined by root-sum-square without further checks.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 左右偏載與合力位置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Left-right loading and resultant position: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「左右偏載與合力位置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Left-right loading and resultant position” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以一致坐標標出左右地層、施工進度與量測反應，確認合力方向和力臂定義；對比偏載情境的預測與拱頂側移，不可用總沉陷較小消除偏載疑慮，需結構與地工人員共同判斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use common coordinates for left-right ground, construction progress and measured response, checking force directions and lever arms. Compare eccentric-load predictions with crown lateral movement. Modest total settlement does not eliminate eccentricity concerns; structural and geotechnical reviewers interpret them jointly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use a common clock and coordinates for both sides, reporting resultant and eccentricity rather than total load alone. An asymmetric construction change goes to design review together with its implications for temporary-wall forces.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：左右資料被分開存檔或時間錯位，會將真實非對稱誤看成兩組正常反應；因此中隔牆的側向需求和外環偏心可能未在施工期模型中被捕捉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Separately stored or mistimed left-right records can make genuine asymmetry look like two normal responses. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objective: 說明「中隔牆偏心與拉壓邊緣」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 軸力偏離中隔牆中心會產生彎矩，兩側邊緣可能一側壓縮一側受拉。線彈性未裂截面可揭示平均值掩蓋的差異，但開裂後必須重新檢討有效剛度與力流，不可直接延用同一分布。 假設單位寬N=500 kN、e=0.10 m、t=0.30 m，M=50 kN·m；σ=N/t±6M/t²=1.667±3.333 MPa，兩緣5與-1.667 MPa。 施工偏差把力流推向牆邊，可能在名義平均壓力可接受時造成拉裂與局部壓碎；如果只量一側，還可能把彎曲誤判為均勻軸向受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「中隔牆偏心與拉壓邊緣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An axial force offset from the temporary-wall center creates bending, potentially compressing one edge and tensioning the other. An uncracked elastic section exposes differences hidden by the mean. Once cracking occurs, effective stiffness and load transfer need reassessment rather than unchanged extrapolation. For a 1 m strip assume N=500 kN, eccentricity e=0.10 m and thickness t=0.30 m. M=50 kN·m; σ=N/t±6M/t²=1.667±3.333 MPa, giving 5 and -1.667 MPa at the edges. Construction deviation may move the load path toward an edge, producing tension or crushing despite a modest nominal mean. Measuring only one side can further misclassify bending as uniform axial loading across the section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wall eccentricity and edge stresses” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 中隔牆偏心與拉壓邊緣：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬N=500 kN、e=0.10 m、t=0.30 m，M=50 kN·m；σ=N/t±6M/t²=1.667±3.333 MPa，兩緣5與-1.667 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=500 kN, eccentricity e=0.10 m and thickness t=0.30 m. M=50 kN·m; σ=N/t±6M/t²=1.667±3.333 MPa, giving 5 and -1.667 MPa at the edges. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use measured wall profiles, connection offsets and crack maps to check eccentricity direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 中隔牆偏心與拉壓邊緣：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中隔牆偏心與拉壓邊緣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.title: 支承剛度與荷載重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support stiffness and load redistribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支承剛度與荷載重分配」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support stiffness and load redistribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中央區形成後，不同支承可共同承載；在理想剛性橫梁下，各支承分得的荷載與剛度成比例。移除其中一項會改變位移和剩餘需求，即使外荷載不變，也不能沿用拆除前的內力。 假設總F=1000 kN、並聯k1=20及k2=30 kN/mm，位移20 mm、分力400與600 kN；移除k1後位移1000/30=33.33 mm。 剩餘支承較柔或已有損傷，重新分配後的位移可能比原預測大，並引發額外偏心；若只確認被拆牆本身可移除，會漏掉承接荷載的系統需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支承剛度與荷載重分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After the central region forms, supports may share load. Under an ideal rigid cross-member their shares are proportional to stiffness. Removing one changes displacement and remaining demand even at unchanged external load, so pre-removal internal forces cannot simply be retained. Assume total F=1000 kN and parallel stiffnesses k1=20 and k2=30 kN/mm. Displacement is 20 mm and forces are 400 and 600 kN. Removing k1 gives 1000/30=33.33 mm. If the remaining support is flexible or damaged, redistribution can produce greater movement and additional eccentricity than expected. Checking only that the wall itself can be removed misses the demands on the system taking over its load. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support stiffness and load redistribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 支承剛度與荷載重分配：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支承剛度與荷載重分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support stiffness and load redistribution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總F=1000 kN、並聯k1=20及k2=30 kN/mm，位移20 mm、分力400與600 kN；移除k1後位移1000/30=33.33 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume total F=1000 kN and parallel stiffnesses k1=20 and k2=30 kN/mm. Displacement is 20 mm and forces are 400 and 600 kN. Removing k1 gives 1000/30=33.33 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對模型是否真能視為共同位移的並聯支承，再比較移除前後的位移和內力資料；材料齡期、接縫與地層接觸改變須分別建模，不能只把被移除構件從圖上刪去而保持其他內力不變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether shared displacement really supports a parallel-spring idealization, then compare pre- and post-change movements and force evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.title: 支承剛度與荷載重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support stiffness and load redistribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支承剛度與荷載重分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instructionEn: Check whether shared displacement really supports a parallel-spring idealization, then compare pre- and post-change movements and force evidence. Model material age, joints and changed ground contact separately. Erasing a removed member from the drawing while retaining all other forces is not analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: A removal review identifies the recipient of each force component and includes age and verification evidence for the replacement system. Formal procedures follow designer approval; this spring example specifies no removal sequence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剩餘支承較柔或已有損傷，重新分配後的位移可能比原預測大，並引發額外偏心；若只確認被拆牆本身可移除，會漏掉承接荷載的系統需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the remaining support is flexible or damaged, redistribution can produce greater movement and additional eccentricity than expected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 支承剛度與荷載重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support stiffness and load redistribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支承剛度與荷載重分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support stiffness and load redistribution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剩餘支承較柔或已有損傷，重新分配後的位移可能比原預測大，並引發額外偏心；若只確認被拆牆本身可移除，會漏掉承接荷載的系統需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the remaining support is flexible or damaged, redistribution can produce greater movement and additional eccentricity than expected. Checking only that the wall itself can be removed misses the demands on the system taking over its load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剩餘支承較柔或已有損傷，重新分配後的位移可能比原預測大，並引發額外偏心；若只確認被拆牆本身可移除，會漏掉承接荷載的系統需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Checking only that the wall itself can be removed misses the demands on the system taking over its load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外荷載不變就表示拆除一個支承後其他構件內力不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged external loading means that removing one support cannot change forces in the others." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 剩餘支承較柔或已有損傷，重新分配後的位移可能比原預測大，並引發額外偏心；若只確認被拆牆本身可移除，會漏掉承接荷載的系統需求。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支承剛度與荷載重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support stiffness and load redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要平均分到各支承的力不大，缺少構件就沒有影響。
剩餘支承較柔或已有損傷，重新分配後的位移可能比原預測大，並引發額外偏心；若只確認被拆牆本身可移除，會漏掉承接荷載的系統需求。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Missing members have no effect as long as the average force per support looks modest.
If the remaining support is flexible or damaged, redistribution can produce greater movement and additional eccentricity than expected.
quiz.explanation: 剩餘支承較柔或已有損傷，重新分配後的位移可能比原預測大，並引發額外偏心；若只確認被拆牆本身可移除，會漏掉承接荷載的系統需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the remaining support is flexible or damaged, redistribution can produce greater movement and additional eccentricity than expected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 暫時構件減少與需求缺口：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Temporary-member reduction and demand gap: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary-member reduction and demand gap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受力構件數量減少時，總可用抗力與個別需求都可能改變；將額定值簡單相加只是一個理想上限，實際分配受剛度、偏心及連接控制。即使這個理想上限不足，也不應靠平均分攤掩蓋缺口。 假設四個獨立同向支承各有200 kN已給定能力，總800 kN；少一個後僅600 kN，對假設需求700 kN差100 kN，未含分項與群體效應。 若構件尚未達齡期或接點未完成卻被算入可用數量，能力表會高估實際系統；逐項少算需求又可能讓總表看似平衡，掩蓋某一關鍵施工階段的缺口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing load-carrying members can change both available resistance and individual demand. Adding nominal values is only an ideal upper bound because stiffness, eccentricity and connections govern distribution. If even that upper bound is insufficient, averaging cannot remove the gap. Assume four independent supports with supplied same-direction resistance 200 kN each, totaling 800 kN. With one absent, 600 kN remains against assumed demand 700 kN, leaving a 100 kN gap before factors or group effects. Counting members before adequate age or connection completion overstates the available system. Understating separate demands can then make the totals appear balanced while concealing a gap at a critical construction stage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Temporary-member reduction and demand gap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均分到各支承的力不大，缺少構件就沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Missing members have no effect as long as the average force per support looks modest." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Temporary-member reduction and demand gap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 共同基準與相關誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared reference and correlated uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共同基準與相關誤差」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shared reference and correlated uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 左右導坑量測常共用基準，因此誤差可能相關；平方和只適用獨立分量。若要比較組合量，必須依加減方向包含共變異數，不然資料看似精密也可能低估或高估實際不確定度。 假設相加量兩項標準差2與3 mm、相關係數ρ=0.5，σ=√(2²+3²+2×0.5×2×3)=4.36 mm；若獨立則3.61 mm。 把共用基準的資料當完全獨立會錯估合成不確定度，導致異常判定過度敏感或不夠敏感；若正負號也混淆，左右差異甚至可能被錯誤放大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共同基準與相關誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measurements in both drifts may share a reference, creating correlated errors. Root-sum-square applies only to independent components. For a combined quantity, covariance must follow the chosen addition or subtraction; otherwise apparent precision can understate or overstate uncertainty. For a sum, assume standard deviations 2 and 3 mm and correlation ρ=0.5. σ=√(2²+3²+2×0.5×2×3)=4.36 mm; independence would give 3.61 mm. Treating shared-reference data as independent misstates combined uncertainty and can make anomaly detection too sensitive or too insensitive. Confusing signs adds another error and may exaggerate a left-right difference that the observations do not support. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shared reference and correlated uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: A staged model activates members according to actual completion before it can be compared with observations. Small total error does not make every stage credible. Assume withheld observations 4, 7 and 10 mm with predictions 5, 7 and 8 mm. Errors are 1, 0 and -2 mm; RMSE=√[(1²+0²+2²)/3]=1.29 mm. Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy. Systematic underprediction after removal can also be diluted by good early fits when only a whole-history average is reported. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Staged model and withheld validation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.text: 檢查校準與驗證資料是否真正分離，將殘差對照中隔牆狀態與開挖時序；若後期持續低估，須檢討構件啟用、剛度及荷載邊界，不能只用全期RMSE較小便宣稱下一階段已驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Verify that calibration and validation data are separate, comparing residuals with wall status and excavation chronology. Persistent late underprediction requires reviewing member activation, stiffness and load boundaries. A small whole-history RMSE does not validate the next stage automatically.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 模型版本記錄每個構件的啟用日期與校準資料集，保留後期驗證不回填；拆除相關預測與實際差異由模型和暫時工程負責人共同審查。
knowledge.textEn: Model versions record activation dates and calibration datasets, keeping later validation genuinely separate. Modeling and temporary-works leads jointly review differences between removal-related predictions and observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「階段模型與保留驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged model and withheld validation"?

檢查校準與驗證資料是否真正分離，將殘差對照中隔牆狀態與開挖時序；若後期持續低估，須檢討構件啟用、剛度及荷載邊界，不能只用全期RMSE較小便宣稱下一階段已驗證。
外荷載不變就表示拆除一個支承後其他構件內力不變。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Verify that calibration and validation data are separate, comparing residuals with wall status and excavation chronology.
Unchanged external loading means that removing one support cannot change forces in the others.

quiz.explanationEn: Verify that calibration and validation data are separate, comparing residuals with wall status and excavation chronology. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 階段模型與保留驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged model and withheld validation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「階段模型與保留驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Staged model and withheld validation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy. Systematic underprediction after removal can also be diluted by good early fits when only a whole-history average is reported. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型全期平均誤差很小便表示每一次構件變更都可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small whole-history average error makes every modeled member change reliable and validated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「階段模型與保留驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining.
Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」與「施工狀態清單與交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths" and "Construction-state register and handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中隔牆移除後，原接觸和施工縫會成為必須確認的防水介面；外部水頭不會因牆被拆除而消失。局部平面水壓合力可顯示需求尺度，但接縫滲漏與結構傳力要分別驗證。 假設淡水水頭18 m，p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa；在假設平面面積1.5 m²上F=264.87 kN，未代表整個曲面襯砌的合力。 拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After a dividing wall is removed, former contacts and construction joints become interfaces requiring waterproofing verification. External head does not disappear with wall removal. A local planar pressure resultant illustrates scale, while leakage paths and structural transfer need separate checks. Assume freshwater head 18 m: p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa. On an ideal plane area 1.5 m², F=264.87 kN; this is not the resultant over the whole curved lining. A recess or construction joint left without compatible treatment can form an interface seepage path. Lack of early leakage does not establish durability, because a later head change may be what exposes the defect. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑
knowledge.text: 中隔牆移除後，原接觸和施工縫會成為必須確認的防水介面；外部水頭不會因牆被拆除而消失。局部平面水壓合力可顯示需求尺度，但接縫滲漏與結構傳力要分別驗證。
knowledge.textEn: After a dividing wall is removed, former contacts and construction joints become interfaces requiring waterproofing verification. External head does not disappear with wall removal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths" is correct?
options: 中隔牆移除後，原接觸和施工縫會成為必須確認的防水介面；外部水頭不會因牆被拆除而消失。
暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。
交接完成率夠高就能把所有剩餘項目視為行政細節。
optionsEn: After a dividing wall is removed, former contacts and construction joints become interfaces requiring waterproofing verification.
Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining.
A high completion percentage makes every remaining handover item merely an administrative detail.

quiz.explanationEn: After a dividing wall is removed, former contacts and construction joints become interfaces requiring waterproofing verification. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設淡水水頭18 m，p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa；在假設平面面積1.5 m²上F=264.87 kN，未代表整個曲面襯砌的合力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater head 18 m: p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa. On an ideal plane area 1.5 m², F=264.87 kN; this is not the resultant over the whole curved lining. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Locate exposed joints, repairs and waterproof continuity after removal, checking consistency between external head and drainage design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設淡水水頭18 m，p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa；在假設平面面積1.5 m²上F=264.87 kN，未代表整個曲面襯砌的合力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater head 18 m: p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa. On an ideal plane area 1.5 m², F=264.87 kN; this is not the resultant over the whole curved lining.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths", which statement holds?
options: 左右總荷載加總正確就不必檢查合力的位置。

steps.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Locate exposed joints, repairs and waterproof continuity after removal, checking consistency between external head and drainage design. Approved quality tests verify interfaces. A dry surface does not exclude future head increase, so waterproofing and structural leads review the conditions together. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：防水交接另列原中隔牆介面及修補版本，保留覆蓋前證據與維護定位；未閉合項須由相應設計責任人處理，不以無漏水照片取代核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Waterproofing handover identifies former wall interfaces and repair versions, retaining pre-covering evidence and maintenance locations. Responsible designers resolve open items; a photograph without leakage is not a substitute for approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A recess or construction joint left without compatible treatment can form an interface seepage path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。
knowledge.textEn: Locate exposed joints, repairs and waterproof continuity after removal, checking consistency between external head and drainage design. Approved quality tests verify interfaces. A dry surface does not exclude future head increase, so waterproofing and structural leads review the conditions together.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 防水交接另列原中隔牆介面及修補版本，保留覆蓋前證據與維護定位；未閉合項須由相應設計責任人處理，不以無漏水照片取代核准。
knowledge.textEn: Waterproofing handover identifies former wall interfaces and repair versions, retaining pre-covering evidence and maintenance locations. Responsible designers resolve open items; a photograph without leakage is not a substitute for approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要平均分到各支承的力不大，缺少構件就沒有影響。
將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.

knowledge.textEn: An outdated temporary-state record can make later staff assume a support remains or a waterproof repair is complete. Maintenance decisions may then rely on a nonexistent member or an interface whose condition has never been verified.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
